employment.instructions: Apply Jobverify defaults to this vacancy, not incidental people. An actual intern role or student-only eligibility (currently pursuing bachelors or masters) means internship. Contract means contract. Completed graduates are full-time. A management trainee is not automatically an intern. Category defaults override conflicting employer fields. Select unspecified when evidence is insufficient.

criteria.full_time: A permanent or regular full-time employee role, including full-time graduate or management trainee programmes.
criteria.internship: The vacancy itself is an internship or student intern placement.
criteria.contract: A fixed-term, temporary, freelance, or contract role.
criteria.other: An explicit different arrangement, such as part-time or an apprenticeship.
criteria.unspecified: Insufficient or conflicting evidence about employment arrangement.

experience.instructions: Apply Jobverify defaults even when employer requirements conflict. Interns and mandatory current students map to zero. Current-year or recently completed graduates map to zero. Older graduation cohorts map to reference year minus graduation year (1-15), implying prior required. Use required work years, not preferred or career-break years. Established managers or required prior experience without years map to 1-15. Defaults are filter inferences, not verified work history.

criteria.fresher_eligible: Applicants without prior professional experience can qualify, including graduate recruitment. Preferred experience does not exclude freshers.
criteria.prior_required: Prior professional experience is mandatory, or the role clearly requires established management or senior professional responsibilities.
criteria.mixed: Explicit alternative eligibility paths allow both freshers and experienced applicants.
criteria.not_stated: No reliable statement of experience eligibility, or contradictory requirements.

seniority.instructions: Classify the seniority of the vacancy itself, considering title and actual responsibilities. Managing interns does not make the manager an intern. Management trainee is not a manager merely because its title contains management.

criteria.mid: Established individual contributor at mid level.
criteria.senior: Senior, staff, or principal individual contributor.
criteria.leadership: Lead, manager, director, vice president, or executive with leadership responsibilities.
criteria.internship: The vacancy itself is an intern placement.
criteria.unknown: Insufficient or contradictory evidence about seniority.

leadership.instructions: Which leadership level describes this vacancy? Select unknown if it is not a leadership role. A management trainee is not a manager.

criteria.manager: Manager responsible for a team or function.
criteria.senior_manager: Senior manager or head of a management function.
criteria.unknown: Not a leadership vacancy, or level not determinable.
